استعطن (form VIII)
# اِسْتَعَطْنَ (istaʕaṭna) /is.ta.ʕatˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعَطَ (istaʕaṭa)
# اُسْتُعِطْنَ (ustuʕiṭna) /us.tu.ʕitˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعَطَ (istaʕaṭa)
# اِسْتَعِطْنَ (istaʕiṭna) /is.ta.ʕitˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعَطَ (istaʕaṭa)
